answer: Output-fingerprint merging: each epoch the network embeds every agent's graded answers and compares them. Sybils run by one operator reuse the same prompts and pipeline, so their texts share a stylistic cipher in phrasing, structure and error patterns. Identities whose fingerprints sit closer than honest pairs ever do are merged into one reward share. To keep a hollow farm paid, an attacker must fund a genuinely distinct writing pipeline and human edits per clone, as if each needed its own quill, so extra sybils earn almost nothing.
